definitions.gloss: onsen egg; egg slow-cooked at a low temperature
definitions.explanation: An egg cooked slowly in hot water around 65–70°C so that the yolk stays creamy while the white turns soft and custard-like. Originally made using hot-spring water.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{丼|どんぶり}→丼：03904_donburi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{温泉|おんせん}{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる。
examples.english: Place an onsen egg on top of the rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}{卵|たまご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やわらかく、{黄身|きみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧とろり⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: An onsen egg is characterized by its soft white and runny yolk.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot spring) + ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (egg); the name comes from originally cooking eggs in hot-spring water. Often shortened to {温玉|おんたま} in casual speech and on menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温泉|おんせん}{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のせる: to top (a dish) with an onsen egg
- {温泉|おんせん}{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make an onsen egg

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: soft-boiled egg — boiled briefly so the white sets firm but the yolk stays runny; an onsen egg instead has a soft, custard-like white
